## Outcome

Describe the need and observed behavior. Include version, application and platform when relevant.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] State an observable result.

## Scope and evidence

Link relevant source, examples or sanitized logs. Identify affected runtime profiles and neighboring behavior.

## Ownership and handoff

The implementing session records its claim, neutral session identifier, branch/PR and next action in a comment after checking existing ownership. Leave another active session's resources intact.

## Decision or constraint

Record an actual product choice, authorization boundary or environment limitation, if one exists.
